title: Fixed Side-Cup Crown Fruit Picker
description: One complete original static long-pole fruit-picker appearance. A full straight wooden pole carries a high side-mounted deep hollow collection cup via a sleeve and two short solid side supports. The cup has a complete thick bottom, inner wall, low rear lip and an integral front crown of broad inward-returning teeth separated by genuine open notches. Cup axis runs parallel to the long pole, unlike an end-mounted coplanar landing-net hoop, two padded litter jaws or a ground basket with handles. Five closed editable meshes and three opaque PBR roles; one prop and zero scenes. Fixed upright display on a genuine finite pole-end face, not a stability or use pose guarantee. No fruit, harvesting action, load, retention, human fit, spring, motion, manufacture or safety certification.
